# Scale applied to the county faith and culture effects (i.e. county population)
# Should be equal to the sum of the provinces values (which should be at least 0)
# Scope: county
V_kCAFG_county_values_scale = {
    every_county_province = { add = V_kCAFG_province_values_scale }
    min = 1
}

V_kCAFG_presence_factor_color_R = {
    value = 1.5
}

V_kCAFG_presence_factor_color_G = {
    value = 127
}

V_kCAFG_presence_factor_color_B = {
    value = 0
}
